query: Which data-to-qubit encoding strategies (angle, amplitude, re-uploading, learned classical projection) are preferred under NISQ limits for spatial permeability inputs?

response.query: Which data-to-qubit encoding strategies (angle, amplitude, re-uploading, learned classical projection) are preferred under NISQ limits for spatial permeability inputs?
response.answer: Under NISQ limits, amplitude encoding is preferred for spatial permeability inputs due to its compact representation and reduced qubit requirements. Angle encoding is also used for its flexibility in parametrizing qubits. Re-uploading and learned classical projection are less common due to higher computational costs.
